thread:
Alex W: Quick q — if we change the default model for /generate (unpinned), do we guarantee the response will keep field `choices[*].meta` for 6 months? We depend on that in mobile SDK.
Maria C: Short answer: no, we don't promise arbitrary subfields. We guarantee top-level `text`/`tokens` and `usage` shape for backwards compat. :slightly_frowning_face:
Devon P: Could we add a compatibility header like `Accept-Compatibility: legacy-meta` that triggers a server shim for 6 months? It'd avoid forcing clients to pin.
Sanjay R: Sounds reasonable, but streaming paths are trickier. Mobile uses streaming chunks that include `chunk.meta` — we need to ensure shim also works for SSE/GRPC streaming.
Tara M: Re mobile: we can't break streaming envelope without a migration. We rely on `id`+`meta.request_id` being present in first chunk to map responses.
Maria C: Implementation option: server accepts `Accept-Compatibility: legacy-meta` and emits legacy fields in both streaming and non-streaming paths. We can gate behind rollout flag and cost-meter it.
Devon P: I'll prototype shim. Two questions: 1) header name? 2) deprecation window length? Propose header `X-Accept-legacy-meta: true` and 90 days deprecation.
Alex W: 90 days sounds tight for folks on older SDKs. Can we do 180 days? Mobile releases are slower.
Maria C: 180 days is OK if we do a phased removal with a public deprecation notice and SDK patches. We'll need approval from legal for comms timeline for customers with contracts.
Sanjay R: Perf concern: shimming will add ~5-8% CPU on token emission path in my rough estimate. Need perf run and spike test on dedicated nodes.
Devon P: PR up: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/4234 — adds header parsing and shim middleware. Perf test pending. :eyes:
ops-bot: Deploy job 4592 started for branch `feature/legacy-meta-shim` — staging
Devon P: Tests passing on staging, streaming shim seems ok for small payloads. I need help running large-scale perf. @Sanjay R can you schedule a 1-hour spike window?
Sanjay R: I can do Wed 09:00 PT. I'll reserve `dedicated-spike-3` and run 10k streams/min.
Tara M: I'll update mobile SDK changelog and add a note to the migration doc pointing to the header. Also add a runtime check to warn if `meta` missing.
Alex W: Action items: Maria -> coordinate legal/comms + decide final deprecation date. Devon -> hook perf tests and attach numbers to PR. S Jay -> run spike Wed 09:00 PT. Tara -> SDK notice + runtime warning.
Maria C: I'll draft deprecation notice by EOD tomorrow and loop in @legal. If we go 180 days, plan: announce, 30 day opt-in, 120 day maintained shim, final removal with 30-day last warning.
Alex W: Thanks all. Please drop a short comment in the PR when you've done your item so I can track. :thumbsup:
Devon P: noted, will update PR with perf results after spike.
Tara M: ping me for SDK review once PR is green — I'll prioritize.
Alex W: closing loop for now, will follow up after spike. Thanks!
